about: Four original heroes, chosen after character creation. Each sets a name, a line and a small passive.

rows.label: Halvard Stone-Fist
rows.quote: Legion taught me to march. The dead taught me to run.

rows.label: Gorza gra-Bor
rows.quote: I forged my own hammer. You will not like where it lands.

rows.label: Saffir al-Rihad
rows.quote: Steel is a song. The dead never learn the words.

rows.label: Eldrith Vael
rows.quote: I have read what the Thalmor buried. The Coffer and I understand each other.
